item.title: IDF: Iran, Lebanon campaigns at full throttle
item.description: The IDF is pressing on with its operational campaign in Iran and Lebanon, dismissing White House signals of an imminent deal with Tehran. Military commanders say the plan is unchanged, 85% of Iran's air defense array has been destroyed, and overnight strikes hit IRGC command centers in Tehran. item.title: Tehran residents dismiss prospects of genuine US-Iran diplomacy
item.description: Residents of Tehran interviewed by Reuters have dismissed the prospect of genuine US-Iran negotiations, citing years of failed diplomatic rounds as reason for deep skepticism. Tehran resident Mahshid Moradi said she doubts any real talks will materialize, while an unnamed man accused Trump of using diplomacy to "manipulate public opinion."
